Items left on board are taken to the ticket window at Pennet Landing at the end of each day.

This month: two umbrellas, a child's blue raincoat, a set of keys on a lighthouse key ring and
a library book about knots.

Unclaimed items go to the charity shop on Quay Street after a month.
